Ogige FreeTV nwere otu ntụgharị-ụwa, ahụmịhe mba, yana ihe nzacha asụsụ 84+, ụdị ọdịnaya 25+, ọkpụkpọ onyonyo na foto, ọkacha mmasị ị nwere ike kpakpando wee gaagharị, bọtịnụ ọwa na-enweghị usoro, na otu pịa wụnye ozugbo site na Chrome ma ọ bụ Safari - enweghị ụlọ ahịa ngwa achọrọ.
seo.homeFaq4Q: Ogige FreeTV nwekwara redio na kamera weebụ?
seo.homeFaq4A: Ee. Ogige FreeTV nwekwara taabụ Redio nwere ọdụ dị ndụ n'ofe ụdị dị ka Pop, Jazz, na Talk, yana taabụ kamera nwere ntanetịime igwefoto dị ndụ sitere na gburugburu ụwa. Gbanwee taabụ n'elu ụwa.
seo.homeFaq5Q: Kedu ka ogige FreeTV si dị iche na radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5A: Ogige FreeTV bụ ọrụ dị iche, na-arụ ọrụ onwe ya - ejikọtaghị ya na radio.garden. Ọ na-enye interface dị mfe, nghọta karịa nke nwere igodo dị mfe, ma gafere redio nwere TV dị ndụ na kamera weebụ arụnyere n'ime otu ngwaọrụ efu, otu mgbata.
seo.homeFaq6Q: Kedu ihe mere ibe akwụkwọ ubi FreeTool TV ochie na Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6A: Ọ maliteghachiri ebe a. Ibe nke na-ebibu na freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden bụ otu oru ngo, na-arụ ugbu a n'okpuru aha ya na ngalaba: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq7A: Enweghị akaụntụ achọrọ. Ogige FreeTV anaghị arịọ maka email, paswọọdụ, ma ọ bụ nkọwa nkeonwe ọ bụla ikiri.
seo.homeFaq8A: Ee - Ogige FreeTV na-arụ na ihe nchọgharị mkpanaka ọgbara ọhụrụ ọ bụla na gam akporo ma ọ bụ iPhone, enwere ike itinye ya na ihuenyo ụlọ gị maka ịnweta otu mgbata (lee ngalaba ntinye n'elu).
seo.homeFaq9Q: Kedu ihe kpatara ọwa na-egosi "Ọ dịghị"?
seo.homeFaq9A: Ọwa bụ iyi ndụ sitere n'aka ndị mgbasa ozi ọha, yabụ ụfọdụ na-aga n'ịntanetị nwa oge n'ihi ihe nkesa nke onye mgbasa ozi nwere. Gbalịa ọwa ọzọ, ma ọ bụ lelee azụ ma emechaa - ọtụtụ na-alọta n'ime nkeji ole na ole ruo awa.
seo.homeFaq10Q: iyi ndị a nwere iwu ikiri?
seo.homeFaq10A: Ogige FreeTV na-achịkọta iyi ndụ ọha dị n'ihu ọha - nke sitere na ndekọ obodo iptv-org - na anaghị akwado ma ọ bụ chekwaa faịlụ vidiyo ọ bụla n'onwe ya. Lee ngalaba Iwu & Nchekwa n'okpuru maka ihe ndị ọzọ.
